editorial_review.scope: All 43 verses aligned then reread against native Hebrew by lemma and French occurrence.
notes: Gen 36:1–14: genealogical names and kinship formulas; marked supplied French wording and grouped comparative and causal expressions.
Gen 36:15–30: clan titles and repeated names linked to their specific occurrences, with supplied copulas contextual.
Gen 36:31–43: succession formulas, compound names and nominal clauses; preserved LSG forms and the source's distinctions between names.
editorial_review.limitations: Both editorial passes by same editor; no independent audit or dictionary-sense verification. Publication checks deferred.
